issues: React hydration warning in console: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' originating from MonteCarloPanel.jsx line 56 — appears to be tooling-injected source-map span inside <option>. Dev-only warning, no functional impact, but noisy in DevTools.

'Made with Emergent' floating widget sits at bottom-right and visually overlaps the Workspace tab hit-area at 1440x900. Real users can still tap (widget doesn't cover the whole button), but Playwright pixel-precise .click() without force can be intercepted. JS-invoked click works fine. Consider adding right padding to BottomNav or lowering the widget's z-index.
